pages.text: Before moving on to the steel chapter, make sure you have:$(br2)$(li)A steady supply of $(item)fireproof bricks$(), as blocks: the blast furnace walls, the blast stoves, the output and the hatch all use them.

$(li)A heated compacting line for $(item)cast iron ingots$(), and a press making $(item)cast iron sheets$().$(li)A stack of $(item)cast iron pipes$() and a few $(item)cast iron fluid tanks$().$(li)At least one $(item)coke oven$() and plenty of $(item)coal$(): the blast furnace burns $(item)coal coke dust$(), which is coal coke through crushing wheels.

$(li)A $(item)limesand$() line: honey, flowing lava, a drill and crushing wheels.$(li)$(item)Iron$() for the furnace: raw iron or crushed raw iron, both work.$(li)A $(item)casting basin$(), to turn molten steel into ingots.

The $(item)blast furnace reinforcement$() needs steel and heavy plates: build the furnace with plain fireproof bricks first, and reinforce it later.$(br2)Next chapter: coal coke, hot air and your first steel.
